posts.title: Red Arrows Take To America
posts.description: The RAF Red Arrows are in America to support celebrations of 250 years of America's declaration of independence. So, I followed in FlightGear.

posts.title: My Writing Tablet Progress
posts.description: I've spent six months writing on my Android tablet and it's been a blast, so far, most things have stayed the same and my experience has been just as great as in the first place.
